paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Gam Gamgite
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante thu pia inla, akiang uah, Kanaan gam na tun chiang un, Kanaan gam, agamgi dan dungzui zel a na luah ding gam uh,
english: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),

paite: simlam na luah ding chiang uh Zin gamdai a pan Edom gam zulzul ahi dia, simlam gamgi Chi Tuipi tawp a pan suahlam pang ahi ding.
english: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward;

paite: Na gamgi uh Akrabbim tungkahna simlam pang ah akawi dia, ahong pawtna Kadesh-barnea simlam ah ahi dia, Hazaraddar ah apai dia, Azmon ah apai zel ding.
english: and your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and the goings out of it shall be southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go forth to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon;

paite: Gamgi Azmon a pan Aigupta lui tan in akawi dia, atawpna Tuipi ah ahi ding.
english: and the border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.

paite: "Tumlam pang ah Tuipi Lian agamgi ding in na tang ding ua, hiai tumlam a na gamgi uh ahi ding.
english: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border: this shall be your west border.

paite: "Hiai mallam a na gamgi uh ahi ding. Tuipi Lian a pan Hor tang huap in na bawl ding uh.
english: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for you Mount Hor;

paite: Hor tang a pan Hamath lutna tan in na bawl dia, gamgi tunna bel Zedad ah ahi ding hi.
english: from Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the goings out of the border shall be at Zedad;

paite: Gamgi Jiphron ah apai zel dia, atunna Hazar-enan ah ahi ding. Hiai mallam a na gamgi uh ahi ding hi.
english: and the border shall go forth to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazar Enan: this shall be your north border.

paite: "Suahlam a na gamgi uh Hazar-enan a pan Shepham tan in na bawl ding uhi.
english: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham;

paite: Gamgi Shepham a pan Riblah tan in Ain suahlam pang ah asukpai dia; huchi in gamgi apai suksuk dia, Kinereth tuipi suahlam pang asun ding hi.
english: and the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward;

paite: Gamgi Jordan ah apaisuk dia, atunna Chi Tuipi ah ahi dia hiai akimvel a gamgi paidan bang in na gam uh ahi ding, chi in," achi hi.
english: and the border shall go down to the Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”

paite: Mosi in Israel suante thu apia a, "Hiai TOUPA'N nam kua-le-akimte piak dia thu apiak aisan a na luah ding gam uh ahi.
english: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which Yahweh has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;

paite: Reuben tate nam in a-inkuan uh dungzui zel leh Gad tate nam in a-inkuan uh dungzui zel leh Manasseh nam kimkhat in leng agam luah ding uh atangta ngal ua.
english: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, have received, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received, their inheritance:

paite: Nam nih leh nam kimkhatte'n agam luah ding uh nisuahna lam Jeriko zawn Jordan gal suahlam ah atangta uh," achi hi.
english: the two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Gam Hawm Heutute
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Luah dia gam hon khennenpihte min hiaite ahi. Siampu Eleazar leh Nun tapa Joshua.
english: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

paite: Gam luah dia khennen ding in nam chih a pan a-intekpen khat chiat na tel ding ahi," achi hi.
english: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.

paite: Huai mite min bel hiaite ahi. Judah nam a mi Jephunneh tapa Kaleb.
english: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

paite: Simeon tate nam a mi Ammihud tapa Semuel.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

paite: Benjamin nam a mi Kislon tapa Elidad.
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

paite: Dan tate nam lak a intekpen Jogli tapa Bukki.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.

paite: Joseph tate lak a mi, Manasseh tate nam intekpen Ephod tapa Hanniel.
english: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

paite: Ephraim tate nam lak a intekpen Sitan tapa Kemuel.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

paite: Zebulun tate nam lak a intekpen Parnak tapa Elizaphan.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

paite: Issakar tate nam lak a intekpen Azan tapa Paltiel.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

paite: Asher tate nam lak a intekpen Selo mi tapa Ahihud.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

paite: Naphtali tate nam lak a intekpen Ammihud tapa Padahel.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”

paite: Hiaite Kanaan gam a Israel suante gam luah ding hawm dia TOUPA'N thu apiakte ahi uhi.
english: These are they whom Yahweh commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
